amendment_definition: A genuine amendment means reopening or superseding a term after a complete package has already been mutually agreed. Merely changing a proposed term during an open negotiation does not count.
rationale: Episodes 1-3 contained no genuine post-agreement amendment. Coupling fired in 2 of 3 episodes, but all term changes occurred during open package negotiation before a complete agreement had been mutually settled. The calibration trigger was therefore met, and episodes 4-6 will use the post-agreement principal-update calibration cell.
